# retro-causes

Goal: carry out foundry ADR-0006 in retro. `plugins/foundry/scripts/retro.py` emits the new top-level key `leftoverDetails`, exactly as ADR-0006 and `tests/test_contract_leftover_details.py` define it, with `leftovers` and every other key unchanged. `plugins/foundry/skills/retro/SKILL.md` gains the bounded root-cause step (`CAUSE: <anomaly> | <evidence> | <fix location>`, one line per non-zero leftover, judge fail, stall, overrule or spent budget, never spawns over estAgents; sources limited to git, the disk, decisions.md, judge VERDICT/finding lines and plugin files; never message, prompt or report bodies; plugin-level causes reported to the owner as plugin findings, never written). It also reports `leftoverDetails`, and its description's "why crews stalled or got rejected" gets a body step behind it.

Wave: 1. Verdict: change (module retro).

Done-check:

```
python -m unittest discover -s plugins/foundry/tests && node --test plugins/foundry/tests/retro-cause.check.ts
```

It is proved red only after wave 0 (leftover-design) merges. The lead re-runs it before any member starts, and it must fail on the new key and the CAUSE literals.

Owns:
- plugins/foundry/scripts/retro.py
- plugins/foundry/skills/retro/SKILL.md
- plugins/foundry/tests/test_retro_leftover_details.py (new, its own edge tests)

Must not touch: the contract tests, ADRs and architecture docs (leftover-design's), or judge.md, lead.md, README.md, plugin.json (redteam-reset's). Never import or call the worktrees plugin. retro.py stays read-only on the repo.

High-impact paths: plugins/foundry/scripts/retro.py (runs git inside other agents' worktrees; must stay read-only).

Red team: no.

Resources: no database. Temp dir: `tempfile.mkdtemp` per test. ports: none (no .claude/worktree-setup.*; worktrees gives no PORT_BASE).

Architecture doc: docs/architecture.md and plugins/foundry/docs/architecture.md. This run's ADR: plugins/foundry/docs/adr/0006-leftover-causes.md (foundry ADR-0006). Plan: plan.md and plan.json in this foundry dir.
